### Double-Play Ballet

Pivot time: glove to release for the middle infielder on the turn.

```{r}

pivot_summary <- pivots %>%
  group_by(pos) %>%
  summarise(turns = n(), fastest = min(pivot), avg = round(mean(pivot), 2),
            .groups = "drop")

kbl_or_note(pivot_summary, "Double-Play Ballet — pivot time by position",
            "No double-play turns in this sample — raise N_TRACK_GAMES.")
```

### Pop-Time Pipeline

```{r}

pop_summary <- if (nrow(pops) == 0) pops else {
  pops %>%
    summarise(attempts = n(), fastest_exchange = min(exchange),
              avg_exchange = round(mean(exchange), 2),
              avg_throw = round(mean(throw_velo, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
              hardest_throw = round(max(throw_velo, na.rm = TRUE), 1))
}

kbl_or_note(pop_summary, "Pop-Time Pipeline — catcher exchange and throw",
            "No throws to second in this sample — raise N_TRACK_GAMES.")
```

## Fan-Interactive Games

<div class="metric-note">
**The design rule:** a question is only worth asking when the answer is
genuinely uncertain. A prompt the crowd gets right 95% of the time is a
formality, not a game — so every selector below ranks candidates by
**suspense**, not by size.
</div>

### Catch or No Catch?

```{r}

vote_catch <- catch_data %>%
  filter(catch_prob >= 0.25, catch_prob <= 0.75) %>%
  arrange(desc(suspense)) %>%
  transmute(game = game_string, play, fielder = pos, route, hang,
            catch_prob = round(catch_prob, 3),
            answer = if_else(catch_made == 1, "CAUGHT", "DROPS"),
            suspense = round(suspense, 3))

vote_catch %>% head(8) %>%
  kbl_or_note("Catch or No Catch? — plays the model is least sure about")
```

### Out or Safe?

A bang-bang play at first: compare when the throw would arrive against when the
runner did.

```{r}

close_plays <- throws %>%
  select(game_string, play, fielder_id, throw_velo, transfer) %>%
  inner_join(runs %>% select(game_string, play, time_to_first, sprint_mph),
             by = c("game_string", "play")) %>%
  filter(is.finite(time_to_first), is.finite(throw_velo)) %>%
  # rough flight time of the throw from the infield to the bag
  mutate(throw_time = 90 / (throw_velo / MPH),
         margin = round(time_to_first - (transfer + throw_time), 3),
         verdict = if_else(margin < 0, "SAFE", "OUT")) %>%
  arrange(abs(margin))

close_plays %>%
  transmute(game = game_string, play, sprint_mph, time_to_first,
            throw_velo, margin, verdict) %>%
  head(8) %>%
  kbl_or_note("Out or Safe? — the tightest races at first base")
```

### Guess the Gun

```{r}

guess_gun <- pitches %>%
  filter(pitch_velo >= 95) %>%
  arrange(desc(pitch_velo)) %>%
  mutate(low = floor(pitch_velo / 3) * 3 - 3,
         option_a = paste0(low, "-", low + 2),
         option_b = paste0(low + 3, "-", low + 5),
         option_c = paste0(low + 6, "-", low + 8),
         answer = case_when(pitch_velo < low + 3 ~ option_a,
                            pitch_velo < low + 6 ~ option_b,
                            TRUE ~ option_c))

guess_gun %>%
  transmute(game = game_string, play, pitcher = player,
            option_a, option_b, option_c, actual = pitch_velo, answer) %>%
  head(8) %>%
  kbl_or_note("Guess the Gun — three buckets straddling the real reading")
```

### How Far Did It Go?

```{r}

how_far <- hits %>%
  filter(carry >= 330) %>%
  arrange(desc(carry)) %>%
  mutate(low = floor(carry / 25) * 25 - 25,
         option_a = paste0(low, "-", low + 24, " ft"),
         option_b = paste0(low + 25, "-", low + 49, " ft"),
         option_c = paste0(low + 50, "+ ft"),
         answer = case_when(carry < low + 25 ~ option_a,
                            carry < low + 50 ~ option_b,
                            TRUE ~ option_c))

how_far %>%
  transmute(game = game_string, play, batter = player, exit_velo,
            option_a, option_b, option_c, actual = carry, answer) %>%
  head(8) %>%
  kbl_or_note("How Far Did It Go? — 25-foot buckets")
```

### Beat the Burner

The target is how long the runner needed to cover 90 feet at his peak speed.

```{r}

beat_burner <- runs %>%
  filter(!is.na(player)) %>%
  arrange(desc(sprint_mph)) %>%
  mutate(target_seconds = round(90 / (sprint_mph / MPH), 2),
         league_pct = round(100 * percent_rank(sprint_mph), 1))

beat_burner %>%
  transmute(game = game_string, play, runner = player, sprint_mph,
            target_seconds, league_pct) %>%
  head(8) %>%
  kbl_or_note("Beat the Burner — can a fan tap faster than he runs?")
```

## Composite & Storytelling

### Five-Tool Scoreboard

Speed, power and arm are measured in different things, so each is converted to a
**league percentile first** and then averaged. That makes the blend honest and
the output instantly legible: 97 means better than 97% of the league.

```{r}

five_tool <- burner %>%
  select(player, speed = top_mph) %>%
  full_join(smash %>% select(player, power = max_ev), by = "player") %>%
  full_join(cannons %>% select(player, arm = max_throw), by = "player") %>%
  mutate(speed_pct = round(100 * percent_rank(speed), 1),
         power_pct = round(100 * percent_rank(power), 1),
         arm_pct   = round(100 * percent_rank(arm), 1),
         tools = as.integer(!is.na(speed_pct)) + as.integer(!is.na(power_pct)) +
                 as.integer(!is.na(arm_pct)),
         score = round(rowMeans(cbind(speed_pct, power_pct, arm_pct), na.rm = TRUE), 1),
         team = str_split_i(player, "-", 1)) %>%
  filter(tools >= 2) %>%
  arrange(desc(score))

five_tool %>% head(10) %>%
  select(player, team, speed, power, arm, speed_pct, power_pct, arm_pct, tools, score) %>%
  kbl_or_note("Five-Tool Scoreboard — percentile blend of speed, power and arm")
```

### Player of the Game Engine

Not a box score line — a **win probability** line. Batters are credited with
their WPA; pitchers with the negative of the WPA they allowed.

```{r}

potg <- bind_rows(
  pbp %>% group_by(game_string, player = batter) %>%
    summarise(role = "batting", pa = n(), wpa = sum(wpa),
              hits = sum(outcome %in% c("single","double","triple","home_run")),
              rbi = sum(runs), .groups = "drop"),
  pbp %>% group_by(game_string, player = pitcher) %>%
    summarise(role = "pitching", pa = n(), wpa = -sum(wpa),
              hits = NA_integer_, rbi = NA_integer_, .groups = "drop")) %>%
  mutate(score = round(100 * wpa, 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(wpa))

potg %>% head(10) %>%
  transmute(game = game_string, player, role, pa, wpa = round(wpa, 3), score) %>%
  kbl_or_note("Player of the Game — biggest single-game win contributions")
```

### Rivalry Radar

```{r}

rivalry <- pbp %>%
  left_join(hits %>% select(game_string, play, exit_velo),
            by = c("game_string", "last_play" = "play")) %>%
  group_by(team = batting_team) %>%
  summarise(games = n_distinct(game_string), pa = n(),
            runs_per_game = round(sum(runs) / n_distinct(game_string), 2),
            hr = sum(outcome == "home_run"),
            avg_exit_velo = round(mean(exit_velo, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
            high_leverage_pa = sum(leverage >= 2),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(runs_per_game))

rivalry %>% head(12) %>%
  kbl_or_note("Rivalry Radar — team tale of the tape from tracking")
```

### Prospect Spotlight

```{r}

spotlight_player <- five_tool$player[1]

tibble(tool = c("Speed", "Power", "Arm"),
       value = c(five_tool$speed[1], five_tool$power[1], five_tool$arm[1]),
       percentile = c(five_tool$speed_pct[1], five_tool$power_pct[1],
                      five_tool$arm_pct[1])) %>%
  mutate(grade = case_when(percentile >= 97 ~ "ELITE",
                           percentile >= 85 ~ "PLUS-PLUS",
                           percentile >= 70 ~ "PLUS",
                           percentile >= 45 ~ "AVERAGE",
                           TRUE ~ "BELOW AVG")) %>%
  kbl_or_note(paste0("Prospect Spotlight — ", spotlight_player))
```

# Part 4 — The Play Explorer

Everything above is a leaderboard. This is the scoreboard: pick a play from the
win-probability chart and watch it happen, with its metrics underneath.

```{r explorer-games}

# Tracking for a whole season is far too large to embed, so the explorer only
# carries games we actually extracted -- ranked by drama, the biggest single
# swing in each -- and at most three of them.
explorer_games <- pbp %>%
  filter(game_string %in% track_games) %>%
  group_by(game_string) %>%
  summarise(drama = max(abs(wpa)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(drama)) %>%
  head(min(3, length(track_games))) %>%
  pull(game_string)

explorer_pbp <- pbp %>% filter(game_string %in% explorer_games)
```

```{r explorer-tracking}

# Frames for the plays we can replay, trimmed to the live ball and rounded to a
# tenth of a foot -- finer precision is invisible on screen and triples the size
build_frames <- function(gs) {

  keep <- explorer_pbp %>% filter(game_string == gs) %>% pull(last_play)

  bp <- ball_positions %>% filter(game_string == gs) %>% collect() %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>% filter(play_per_game %in% keep)
  pp <- player_positions %>% filter(game_string == gs) %>% collect() %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(play_per_game %in% keep, player_id <= 13)
  ev <- ball_events %>% filter(game_string == gs) %>% collect() %>%
    mutate(across(c(play_per_game, timestamp, ball_eventcode), as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(play_per_game %in% keep)

  out <- list()
  for (pl in keep) {
    b <- bp %>% filter(play_per_game == pl) %>% arrange(timestamp)
    if (nrow(b) < 2) next
    e <- ev %>% filter(play_per_game == pl)

    t0 <- if (any(e$ball_eventcode == EV[["PITCH"]])) {
      min(e$timestamp[e$ball_eventcode == EV[["PITCH"]]]) - 400
    } else min(b$timestamp)
    t1 <- if (any(e$ball_eventcode == EV[["END"]])) {
      max(e$timestamp[e$ball_eventcode == EV[["END"]]]) + 800
    } else max(b$timestamp)

    b <- b %>% filter(timestamp >= t0, timestamp <= t1)
    if (nrow(b) < 2) next
    ts <- b$timestamp

    players <- list()
    for (pid in sort(unique(pp$player_id[pp$play_per_game == pl]))) {
      trk <- pp %>% filter(play_per_game == pl, player_id == pid) %>%
        arrange(timestamp)
      if (nrow(trk) < 2) next
      players[[as.character(pid)]] <- list(
        x = round(approx(trk$timestamp, trk$field_x, ts, rule = 2)$y, 1),
        y = round(approx(trk$timestamp, trk$field_y, ts, rule = 2)$y, 1))
    }

    out[[as.character(pl)]] <- list(
      t  = round(ts - ts[1]),
      bx = round(b$ball_position_x, 1),
      by = round(b$ball_position_y, 1),
      bz = round(b$ball_position_z, 1),
      players = players,
      marks = e %>%
        filter(ball_eventcode %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 11, 16)) %>%
        transmute(t = round(timestamp - ts[1]), code = ball_eventcode))
  }
  out
}

frames <- cached("explorer_frames", {
  setNames(lapply(explorer_games, build_frames), explorer_games)
})
```

```{r explorer-payload}

# Join every metric we computed onto the plays the explorer can show
explorer_rows <- explorer_pbp %>%
  left_join(hits %>% select(game_string, play, exit_velo, launch, carry, barrel),
            by = c("game_string", "last_play" = "play")) %>%
  left_join(pitches %>% select(game_string, play, pitch_velo, extension,
                               induced_break, horizontal_break),
            by = c("game_string", "last_play" = "play")) %>%
  left_join(runs %>% select(game_string, play, sprint_mph, time_to_first, burst),
            by = c("game_string", "last_play" = "play")) %>%
  left_join(catch_data %>% select(game_string, play, pos, route, hang,
                                  catch_prob, robbery),
            by = c("game_string", "last_play" = "play")) %>%
  left_join(throws %>% select(game_string, play, throw_velo, transfer),
            by = c("game_string", "last_play" = "play")) %>%
  mutate(wp_home = if_else(half_inning == "Bottom", wp_after, 1 - wp_after))

# Every pitch thrown in each at-bat, for the tunnel view. A play is one pitch,
# so the at-bat's pitches are the plays between its first and last.
pitch_seq <- explorer_pbp %>%
  # key_play is made with mutate, not select. Naming a column twice in one
  # select() -- once renamed, once not -- keeps only one of them, and the
  # other silently disappears.
  mutate(key_play = last_play) %>%
  select(game_string, key_play, first_play, last_play) %>%
  inner_join(pitches %>% select(game_string, play, pitch_velo, plate_x, plate_z,
                                induced_break, horizontal_break),
             by = "game_string", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(play >= first_play, play <= last_play,
         !is.na(plate_x), !is.na(plate_z)) %>%
  arrange(game_string, key_play, play) %>%
  group_by(game_string, key_play) %>%
  mutate(pitch_no = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

# Keyed "game play" so the browser can look up an at-bat's pitches directly
pitch_map <- split(pitch_seq, paste(pitch_seq$game_string, pitch_seq$key_play))
pitch_map <- lapply(pitch_map, function(d) {
  d %>% transmute(n = pitch_no, x = round(plate_x, 3), z = round(plate_z, 3),
                  velo = pitch_velo, ivb = induced_break, hb = horizontal_break)
})

# Strike zone, calibrated from where pitches actually cross rather than assumed
# (z = 0 in this coordinate system is a datum, not the ground)
zone_src <- pitches %>% filter(!is.na(plate_z))

zone <- if (nrow(zone_src) >= 50) {
  list(bottom = round(unname(quantile(zone_src$plate_z, 0.12)), 2),
       top    = round(unname(quantile(zone_src$plate_z, 0.88)), 2),
       half_width = 0.83)
} else {
  # too few tracked crossings to calibrate; fall back to a nominal zone
  list(bottom = 1.5, top = 3.4, half_width = 0.83)
}

payload <- list(
  games = lapply(explorer_games, function(g) {
    m <- game_info %>% filter(game_string == g) %>% slice(1)
    list(id = g, home = m$home_team, away = m$away_team)
  }),
  zone = zone,
  pitch_map = pitch_map,
  plays = explorer_rows %>%
    transmute(game = game_string, play = last_play, inning, half = half_inning,
              batter, pitcher, outcome, runs, outs = outs_before,
              bases = BASE_LABELS[base_state + 1],
              home_score, away_score, situation,
              wpa = round(wpa, 4), leverage = round(leverage, 2),
              wp_home = round(wp_home, 4), clutch = round(clutch, 1),
              exit_velo, launch, carry, barrel,
              pitch_velo, extension, induced_break, horizontal_break,
              sprint_mph, time_to_first, burst,
              fielder = pos, route, hang,
              catch_prob = round(catch_prob, 3), robbery = round(robbery, 1),
              throw_velo, transfer),
  frames = frames)

payload_json <- toJSON(payload, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null", digits = 4)
```

cat(paste0('<script>\nconst EX = ', payload_json, ';\n'))

cat('
const g = function(i){ return document.getElementById(i); };
let rows = [], sel = 0, t = 0, timer = null;

// Build an SVG element with every attribute quoted.
//
// This matters more than it looks: writing tags by hand as
//   "<rect width="+w+" rx=8/>"
// produces rx="8/" -- the slash is swallowed into the attribute value, the tag
// never closes, and every element after it becomes a child of the rect. SVG
// does not render those, so the whole panel silently goes blank.
function el(tag, attrs, inner){
  let s = "<" + tag;
  for (const k in attrs) {
    if (attrs[k] !== null && attrs[k] !== undefined) {
      s += " " + k + "=\\"" + attrs[k] + "\\"";
    }
  }
  return (inner === undefined || inner === null)
    ? s + "></" + tag + ">"
    : s + ">" + inner + "</" + tag + ">";
}

// ---- filters -------------------------------------------------------------
EX.games.forEach(function(gm){
  const o = document.createElement("option");
  o.value = gm.id; o.textContent = gm.away + " at " + gm.home;
  g("ex-game").appendChild(o);
});
if (EX.games.length) g("ex-game").value = EX.games[0].id;

[...new Set(EX.plays.map(function(p){ return p.outcome; }))].sort().forEach(function(v){
  const o = document.createElement("option");
  o.value = v; o.textContent = String(v).replace(/_/g," ");
  g("ex-type").appendChild(o);
});

function refreshPlayers(){
  const gm = g("ex-game").value;
  const names = [...new Set(EX.plays.filter(function(p){ return p.game === gm; })
                                    .map(function(p){ return p.batter; }))].sort();
  g("ex-player").innerHTML = "<option value=\\"\\">All batters</option>" +
    names.map(function(n){ return "<option>" + n + "</option>"; }).join("");
}

function applyFilters(){
  const gm = g("ex-game").value, ty = g("ex-type").value, pl = g("ex-player").value;
  rows = EX.plays.filter(function(p){
    return p.game === gm && (!ty || p.outcome === ty) && (!pl || p.batter === pl);
  });
  sel = 0; t = 0; stop(); render();
}

// ---- win probability chart, every play marked ----------------------------
function drawChart(){
  const W = 900, H = 300, top = 24, mid = 196, bot = 288;
  const all = EX.plays.filter(function(p){ return p.game === g("ex-game").value; });
  const n = Math.max(1, all.length - 1);
  const x = function(k){ return 34 + (k/n)*(W-58); };
  const y = function(v){ return mid - v*(mid-top); };
  let s = "";

  s += el("rect", {width:W, height:H, fill:"#0f1620", rx:8});

  // 50% reference and axis labels
  s += el("line", {x1:34, y1:y(0.5), x2:W-24, y2:y(0.5),
                   stroke:"#3a4a5c", "stroke-dasharray":"4 4"});
  [0, 0.5, 1].forEach(function(v){
    s += el("text", {x:28, y:y(v)+4, fill:"#6b7c8d", "font-size":10,
                     "text-anchor":"end"}, Math.round(v*100) + "%");
  });

  // inning separators
  let prev = null;
  all.forEach(function(p,k){
    const key = p.inning + p.half;
    if (key !== prev && p.half === "Top") {
      s += el("line", {x1:x(k), y1:top, x2:x(k), y2:mid, stroke:"#1e2b3a"});
      s += el("text", {x:x(k)+3, y:top+10, fill:"#4a5b6c", "font-size":9}, p.inning);
    }
    prev = key;
  });

  // win probability path
  let d = "";
  all.forEach(function(p,k){
    if (p.wp_home === null || p.wp_home === undefined) return;
    d += (d ? "L" : "M") + x(k).toFixed(1) + "," + y(p.wp_home).toFixed(1);
  });
  if (d) s += el("path", {d:d, fill:"none", stroke:"#ffffff", "stroke-width":2});

  // leverage bars
  const lmax = Math.max(2, ...all.map(function(p){ return p.leverage || 0; }));
  all.forEach(function(p,k){
    const h = ((p.leverage||0)/lmax)*(bot-mid-16);
    s += el("rect", {x:x(k)-2, y:bot-h, width:4, height:Math.max(0,h),
                     fill:(p.leverage>=2 ? "#c8102e" : "#2f4a68")});
  });
  s += el("text", {x:34, y:mid+22, fill:"#6b7c8d", "font-size":10}, "LEVERAGE");

  // one dot per play, sized by |WPA| and coloured by who it helped
  all.forEach(function(p,k){
    if (p.wp_home === null || p.wp_home === undefined) return;
    const w = p.wpa || 0;
    const inView = rows.some(function(r){ return r.play === p.play; });
    const isSel = rows.length && rows[sel].play === p.play;
    s += el("circle", {
      cx:x(k), cy:y(p.wp_home),
      r: isSel ? 8 : (3 + Math.min(6, Math.abs(w)*22)),
      fill: isSel ? "#f5c518" : (w >= 0 ? "#21d07a" : "#c8102e"),
      stroke: isSel ? "#000000" : "#0f1620", "stroke-width": isSel ? 2 : 1,
      opacity: inView ? 1 : 0.25,
      style:"cursor:pointer",
      onclick:"exJump(" + p.play + ")"
    });
  });

  s += el("text", {x:34, y:16, fill:"#9fb0c0", "font-size":10},
          "WIN PROBABILITY (" + (EX.games.find(function(gm){
            return gm.id === g("ex-game").value; })||{home:""}).home + ")");
  g("ex-chart").innerHTML = s;
}

// ---- field ---------------------------------------------------------------
const VW = 560, VH = 430, MAXD = 420;
function fx(v){ return VW/2 + (v/MAXD)*(VW/2-16); }
function fy(v){ return VH-26 - (v/MAXD)*(VH-52); }
const LBL = {1:"P",2:"C",3:"1B",4:"2B",5:"3B",6:"SS",7:"LF",8:"CF",9:"RF",
             10:"BAT",11:"R1",12:"R2",13:"R3"};
function colour(id){
  id = +id;
  if (id <= 2) return "#ffffff";
  if (id <= 6) return "#8fd4ff";
  if (id <= 9) return "#ffd54a";
  return "#ff7a90";
}

function fieldBase(){
  const H=[0,0], F=[63.64,63.64], S=[0,127.28], T=[-63.64,63.64];
  const pt = function(p){ return fx(p[0]) + "," + fy(p[1]); };
  let s = el("rect", {width:VW, height:VH, fill:"#0b6b3a", rx:8});

  // outfield arc
  s += el("path", {d:"M " + fx(-MAXD*0.72) + "," + fy(MAXD*0.72) +
                      " A 300 300 0 0 1 " + fx(MAXD*0.72) + "," + fy(MAXD*0.72),
                   fill:"none", stroke:"#ffffff", "stroke-width":1.2, opacity:0.7});
  // infield dirt and basepaths
  s += el("polygon", {points:[pt(H),pt(F),pt(S),pt(T)].join(" "),
                      fill:"#8a5a2b", opacity:0.5});
  s += el("polyline", {points:[pt(H),pt(F),pt(S),pt(T),pt(H)].join(" "),
                       fill:"none", stroke:"#ffffff", "stroke-width":1.8});
  // foul lines
  [F,T].forEach(function(b){
    const nn = Math.hypot(b[0],b[1]);
    s += el("line", {x1:fx(0), y1:fy(0),
                     x2:fx(b[0]/nn*MAXD*0.78), y2:fy(b[1]/nn*MAXD*0.78),
                     stroke:"#ffffff", "stroke-width":1.3});
  });
  // bags and mound
  [F,S,T].forEach(function(b){
    s += el("rect", {x:fx(b[0])-3, y:fy(b[1])-3, width:6, height:6, fill:"#ffffff"});
  });
  s += el("circle", {cx:fx(0), cy:fy(60.5), r:8, fill:"#8a5a2b", stroke:"#ffffff"});
  s += el("polygon", {points:[fx(0)+","+(fy(0)-5), (fx(0)+5)+","+fy(0),
                              fx(0)+","+(fy(0)+5), (fx(0)-5)+","+fy(0)].join(" "),
                      fill:"#ffffff"});
  return s;
}

function track(){
  if (!rows.length) return null;
  const r = rows[sel];
  const byGame = EX.frames[r.game];
  return byGame ? byGame[String(r.play)] : null;
}

function drawField(){
  const tr = track();
  let s = fieldBase();

  if (!tr) {
    g("ex-field").innerHTML = s +
      el("text", {x:18, y:26, fill:"#ffffff", "font-size":12},
         "No tracking for this play");
    return;
  }

  const T = tr.t, dur = T[T.length-1] || 1, ms = Math.min(t, dur);
  let i = 0; while (i < T.length-1 && T[i+1] <= ms) i++;
  const j = Math.min(i+1, T.length-1);
  const span = (T[j]-T[i]) || 1, f = Math.max(0, Math.min(1,(ms-T[i])/span));
  const lp = function(a,b){ return a + (b-a)*f; };

  // ball trail so far
  let d = "";
  for (let k = 0; k <= i; k++) {
    d += (k ? "L" : "M") + fx(tr.bx[k]).toFixed(1) + "," + fy(tr.by[k]).toFixed(1);
  }
  if (d) s += el("path", {d:d, fill:"none", stroke:"#ffffff", "stroke-width":1.4,
                          opacity:0.6, "stroke-dasharray":"3 3"});

  // fielders and runners
  for (const pid in tr.players) {
    const p = tr.players[pid];
    const px = lp(p.x[i], p.x[j]), py = lp(p.y[i], p.y[j]);
    s += el("circle", {cx:fx(px), cy:fy(py), r:6, fill:colour(pid),
                       stroke:"#0a1017", "stroke-width":1.2});
    s += el("text", {x:fx(px), y:fy(py)-9, fill:colour(pid), "font-size":8.5,
                     "text-anchor":"middle", "font-weight":700}, LBL[pid] || pid);
  }

  // the ball, growing as it rises
  const bx = lp(tr.bx[i], tr.bx[j]), by = lp(tr.by[i], tr.by[j]),
        bz = lp(tr.bz[i], tr.bz[j]);
  s += el("circle", {cx:fx(bx), cy:fy(by),
                     r:(4 + Math.max(0, Math.min(9, bz))*0.55),
                     fill:"#ffffff", stroke:"#c8102e", "stroke-width":1.4});

  // Event caption -- only the most recent one in the window. Drawing every
  // match stacks "PITCH" and "CONTACT" on top of each other at the start of
  // a play, which is unreadable.
  const names = {1:"PITCH",4:"CONTACT",2:"FIELDED",3:"THROW",5:"END OF PLAY",
                 10:"OFF THE WALL",11:"HOME RUN",16:"BOUNCE"};
  let caption = null;
  (tr.marks||[]).forEach(function(m){
    if (Math.abs(m.t-ms) < 240 && names[m.code]) caption = names[m.code];
  });
  if (caption) {
    s += el("text", {x:VW/2, y:26, fill:"#f5c518", "font-size":16,
                     "font-weight":800, "text-anchor":"middle"}, caption);
  }

  g("ex-field").innerHTML = s;
  g("ex-clock").textContent = (ms/1000).toFixed(1) + "s";
  g("ex-scrub").value = Math.round(1000*ms/dur);
}

// ---- pitch tunnel, catcher\'s view ----------------------------------------
function drawTunnel(){
  const TW = 420, TH = 360;
  let s = el("rect", {width:TW, height:TH, fill:"#0f1620", rx:8});

  const seq = rows.length
    ? (EX.pitch_map[rows[sel].game + " " + rows[sel].play] || [])
    : [];

  // Show a tight window around the zone (+/- 1.7 ft wide, 0.9 to 3.9 ft high)
  // so the strike zone fills the panel instead of floating in dead space.
  const zx = function(v){ return TW/2 + (v/1.35)*(TW/2 - 45); };
  const zz = function(v){ return TH - 52 - ((v-1.0)/2.7)*(TH-100); };

  const zb = EX.zone.bottom, zt = EX.zone.top, hw = EX.zone.half_width;

  // strike zone, drawn in thirds like a broadcast overlay
  s += el("rect", {x:zx(-hw), y:zz(zt), width:zx(hw)-zx(-hw),
                   height:zz(zb)-zz(zt), fill:"none", stroke:"#ffffff",
                   "stroke-width":2});
  [1,2].forEach(function(k){
    const vx = -hw + (2*hw)*k/3, vz = zb + (zt-zb)*k/3;
    s += el("line", {x1:zx(vx), y1:zz(zt), x2:zx(vx), y2:zz(zb),
                     stroke:"#2f4257", "stroke-width":1});
    s += el("line", {x1:zx(-hw), y1:zz(vz), x2:zx(hw), y2:zz(vz),
                     stroke:"#2f4257", "stroke-width":1});
  });
  s += el("text", {x:TW/2, y:TH-24, fill:"#6b7c8d", "font-size":10,
                   "text-anchor":"middle"}, "catcher\\u2019s view \\u2014 home plate");

  if (!seq.length) {
    s += el("text", {x:20, y:26, fill:"#7d8fa1", "font-size":12},
            "No tracked pitches for this at-bat");
    g("ex-tunnel").innerHTML = s;
    g("ex-tunnel-note").textContent = "";
    return;
  }

  const palette = ["#f5c518","#3d8bff","#21d07a","#c8102e","#a855f7",
                   "#f2994a","#8fd4ff","#ff9ab0"];

  // faint line through the sequence shows how the pitcher moved the hitter around
  let d = "";
  seq.forEach(function(p,k){
    d += (k ? "L" : "M") + zx(p.x).toFixed(1) + "," + zz(p.z).toFixed(1);
  });
  s += el("path", {d:d, fill:"none", stroke:"#3a4a5c", "stroke-width":1,
                   "stroke-dasharray":"3 3"});

  seq.forEach(function(p,k){
    const c = palette[k % palette.length];
    s += el("circle", {cx:zx(p.x), cy:zz(p.z), r:13, fill:c,
                       stroke:"#0a1017", "stroke-width":1.5, opacity:0.92});
    s += el("text", {x:zx(p.x), y:zz(p.z)+4, "font-size":11, "font-weight":800,
                     "text-anchor":"middle", fill:"#0a1017"}, p.n);
  });

  g("ex-tunnel").innerHTML = s;

  // the sequence in words, pitch by pitch
  g("ex-tunnel-note").innerHTML = seq.map(function(p){
    const bits = ["#" + p.n];
    if (p.velo != null) bits.push(p.velo + " mph");
    if (p.ivb  != null) bits.push("IVB " + (p.ivb>0?"+":"") + Math.round(p.ivb) + "\\"");
    return bits.join(" ");
  }).join(" &nbsp;|&nbsp; ");
}

// ---- metric cards --------------------------------------------------------
function kv(k,v,u){
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return "";
  return "<div class=\\"ex-kv\\"><span>" + k + "</span><span>" + v + (u||"") + "</span></div>";
}
function card(title, body){
  return body ? "<div class=\\"ex-card\\"><h5>" + title + "</h5>" + body + "</div>" : "";
}

function drawCards(){
  if (!rows.length) { g("ex-cards").innerHTML = ""; return; }
  const p = rows[sel];
  let h = "";

  h += card("Situation",
    kv("Inning", (p.half==="Top"?"Top ":"Bot ") + p.inning) +
    kv("Outs", p.outs) + kv("Bases", p.bases) +
    kv("Score", p.away_score + " - " + p.home_score));

  h += card("Win Probability",
    kv("WPA", (p.wpa>=0?"+":"") + (p.wpa*100).toFixed(1), "%") +
    kv("Leverage", p.leverage, "x") + kv("Clutch", p.clutch, "/100"));

  h += card("Speed &amp; Baserunning",
    kv("Sprint speed", p.sprint_mph, " mph") +
    kv("Home to first", p.time_to_first, " s") +
    kv("Burst", p.burst, " ft/s2"));

  h += card("Power &amp; Hitting",
    kv("Exit velocity", p.exit_velo, " mph") +
    kv("Launch angle", p.launch, "&deg;") +
    kv("Carry", p.carry, " ft") +
    kv("Barrel", p.barrel === 1 ? "YES" : (p.barrel === 0 ? "no" : null)));

  h += card("Pitching",
    kv("Pitch velocity", p.pitch_velo, " mph") +
    kv("Extension", p.extension, " ft") +
    kv("Induced break", p.induced_break, " in") +
    kv("Horizontal break", p.horizontal_break, " in"));

  h += card("Defense &amp; Fielding",
    kv("Fielder", p.fielder) +
    kv("Ground covered", p.route, " ft") +
    kv("Hang time", p.hang, " s") +
    kv("Catch probability",
       p.catch_prob === null || p.catch_prob === undefined
         ? null : (p.catch_prob*100).toFixed(0), "%") +
    kv("Robbery score", p.robbery, "/100") +
    kv("Throw velocity", p.throw_velo, " mph") +
    kv("Transfer", p.transfer, " s"));

  g("ex-cards").innerHTML = h;
}

// ---- render --------------------------------------------------------------
function render(){
  if (!rows.length) {
    g("ex-narr").textContent = "No plays match these filters.";
    g("ex-cards").innerHTML = "";
    drawChart(); drawField(); drawTunnel();
    return;
  }
  const p = rows[sel];
  g("ex-title").textContent = p.situation;

  let words = p.batter + " \\u2014 " + String(p.outcome).replace(/_/g," ");
  if (p.runs > 0) words += ", " + p.runs + " in";
  words += ". Win probability " + (p.wpa>=0?"+":"") + (p.wpa*100).toFixed(0) +
           "%, leverage " + p.leverage + "x.";
  g("ex-narr").textContent = words;

  drawChart(); drawField(); drawTunnel(); drawCards();
}

function exJump(playId){
  const k = rows.findIndex(function(r){ return r.play === playId; });
  if (k >= 0) { sel = k; t = 0; stop(); render(); }
}
function stop(){
  if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; g("ex-play").innerHTML = "&#9654; Play"; }
}

g("ex-play").onclick = function(){
  if (timer) { stop(); return; }
  const tr = track(); if (!tr) return;
  if (t >= tr.t[tr.t.length-1]) t = 0;
  g("ex-play").innerHTML = "&#10074;&#10074; Pause";
  timer = setInterval(function(){
    const cur = track(); if (!cur) { stop(); return; }
    t += 40;
    if (t >= cur.t[cur.t.length-1]) { t = cur.t[cur.t.length-1]; drawField(); stop(); return; }
    drawField();
  }, 40);
};
g("ex-prev").onclick = function(){ if (sel > 0) { sel--; t = 0; stop(); render(); } };
g("ex-next").onclick = function(){ if (sel < rows.length-1) { sel++; t = 0; stop(); render(); } };
g("ex-scrub").oninput = function(e){
  const tr = track(); if (!tr) return;
  t = tr.t[tr.t.length-1] * (+e.target.value/1000);
  drawField();
};
g("ex-game").onchange = function(){ refreshPlayers(); applyFilters(); };
g("ex-type").onchange = applyFilters;
g("ex-player").onchange = applyFilters;

refreshPlayers();
applyFilters();
</script>')

cat('\n```\n')
```

<span style="color:red">**HOW TO USE IT:**</span>

Pick a game, narrow by play type or batter, then click anywhere on the win
probability line. The field replays that play from the tracking data — all nine
fielders, the runners and the ball, with the ball growing as it rises — and every
metric computed in Part 3 appears in the cards below, grouped by category.

# Closing Notes

**What is deliberately not modelled.** The data contains no umpire calls, so
there is no supervised called-strike probability. There are no stolen-base or
caught-stealing labels, so Pickoff Jump reports measured lead distance instead
of a steal probability. Spin rate cannot be recovered from positional tracking,
so pitch movement is used instead. Inventing any of the three would have been
easy and dishonest.

**Known limitation.** Reaching on an error and a fielder's choice are
indistinguishable from a single when the only signal is base occupancy, which is
why hits run about 10% above the real rate. Every metric that depends on the
distinction is affected in the same direction.

**Reproducing this.** Set `SMT_DATA_ROOT` if the data is not in the parent
folder, then `quarto render SMT_Data_Challenge_2026.qmd`.

Two knobs in the **How much data to process** chunk control the cost:

| | `N_TRACK_GAMES` | `N_MODEL_GAMES` | Roughly |
|---|---|---|---|
| Quick check | 1 | 25 | a minute |
| Working draft | 25 | 250 | a few minutes |
| Full season | 250 | 250 | ~40 minutes, then cached |

`N_TRACK_GAMES` is the expensive one — it reads the 4.5 GB player-positions
directory at about ten seconds a game, and prints each game as it goes.
Leaderboard minimums scale with the sample automatically, so a one-game render
still produces populated tables rather than empty ones.

Results are cached per sample size in `cache/`, so raising a knob only pays for
what it adds, and later renders finish in seconds. Delete `cache/` to force a
rebuild.
